# EdgeORE

Native Kotlin/Compose review candidate by CodesbyFebin for exact-message Solana actions, private AI,
device-bound storage, owned-host operations and verification of signed receipt contents.
This branch adds optional prototype storage/build/consent/evidence tooling. It is not a production
release. Local automated tests do not qualify Android runtime, portable backup or SOL settlement.

- Handoff: docs/HANDOFF-GOOGLE-AI-STUDIO.md
- Extension roadmap: docs/extensions/RESEARCH-AND-ROADMAP.md
- Fork guide: FORK-GUIDE.md
- Storage candidate: docs/storage/INTEGRATION.md
- Build governance: docs/build/ADAPTATION.md
- Offline kit: tools/edgeore-kit/README.md

Do not claim SOL mining, guaranteed earnings, audited compute, vendor endorsement or a project MIT
license. The unsigned artifact manifest checker does not prove who created its contents.
